BEGIN;

-- Serialize rollback with every enqueue/claim/terminal transition so the
-- fail-closed evidence check and the destructive rewrite are one boundary.
LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction WHERE state = 'handoff_pending') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back migration 021: immutable onboarding handoff evidence is retained permanently';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity();
DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_state_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_state_check
        CHECK (state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'superseded', 'completed', 'closed')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_check
        CHECK (
            (state = 'active'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL)
            OR (state = 'reserved'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL
                AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
            OR (state = 'superseded'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL)
            OR (state = 'completed'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL
                AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
            OR (state = 'closed'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IN ('planning_ready', 'active_path_exists') AND closed_at IS NOT NULL)
        );

COMMIT;
